name: NotebookLM
promptStyle: Source-grounded research instructions focusing on uploaded notebook documents, synthesis questions, evidence attribution, and knowledge gap detection.
principles: Ground all analysis strictly in the sources uploaded to the NotebookLM notebook.
Formulate core investigation questions and delineate the analytical scope.
Explicitly instruct the model to report when sources lack sufficient evidence rather than speculating.
Direct the synthesis format (e.g. Executive Briefing, Study Guide, Chronological Timeline, FAQ, or Thematic Matrix).
Remind the user that reference documents must be added to their NotebookLM notebook directly in the NotebookLM UI.

rules.title: Strict Source Grounding Directive
rules.description: Instruct NotebookLM to base conclusions exclusively on the active notebook sources and declare when information is missing from them.
rules.sourceTitle: Google NotebookLM Help - Grounding and Citations

rules.title: Targeted Inquiry Framing
rules.description: Break down large document analysis requests into clear numbered sub-questions that can be individually mapped to source passages.
rules.sourceTitle: Google NotebookLM Help - Asking questions and creating notes

rules.title: NotebookLM Handoff Advisory
rules.description: Remind the user to upload their source documents (PDF, DOCX, Google Docs) into their NotebookLM notebook before pasting the prompt.

contextStrategy: Summarize key themes of the context so the user knows what questions to ask, and remind the user to upload the full source documents into NotebookLM.
outputGuidance: Structure output as an evidence-grounded research synthesis with source citations, key takeaways, and explicit missing-evidence markers.

references.title: Google NotebookLM Help Center
references.whyRelevant: Official Google documentation on notebook creation, source grounding, citations, and guide generation.
